scope: Focused mathematical and literal source-contract review of KTR4-KTR8 and KTR12-KTR13. KTR1-KTR3 and KTR9-KTR11 are consumed at their stated interfaces; their published Kato, base-change and adjoint-vanishing foundations are reviewed separately by the root. This review does not replay Lean or certify formal-source correctness.
findings: KTR4: the inclusion of the ordered ordinary ideal in It is valid even for an empty minimal-prime index set. The three substitutions in the ordered matrix product force the full upper-triangular flag with diagonal (epsilon^e,1,epsilon^-e). The normality/intertwining argument then preserves that same ordering on all inertia; no full crystalline-component theorem is inserted.

KTR5: residual closeness, ell-1 not dividing 2e, and the index-two finite character prove both middle and determinant characters trivial on ell-inertia. H-conjugation preserves them, and the disconnected c action inverts them, so this holds at every place above ell. Away from ell the exact Kill condition gives a finite prime-to-ell inertial image, whose roots congruent to one are trivial. The class-number condition then kills both unramified characters on H.

KTR6: the actual corner matrices lie in SL2 and J2 B^(-t) J2 = D2 B D2. Consequently the defined W on the two cosets is an ordinary continuous representation, with W(c)=diag(-1,1), determinant eta, and the exact IsExt restriction. Corner irreducibility implies global irreducibility.

KTR7: the quadratic self-twist argument covers a unique N-invariant line, two distinct N-characters, and scalar N-action without assuming semisimplicity of the restriction. In the scalar case projective commutativity and the determinant force a nontrivial quadratic character.

KTR8: the ordered inertia line has infinite character kappa. A hypothetical quadratic self-twist on the infinite cyclotomic kernel yields trace zero on a whole inertia coset, hence kappa(s)^4=1 there; multiplying by u^2 gives the contradiction kappa(u)^8=1. The full original cyclotomic kernel, rather than one finite layer, is used.

KTR12: all four projection/section maps were checked on the corner, two off-diagonal blocks and middle entry. The c-action signs distinguish W and W eta, the middle character is eta, and the reconstruction formula has the correct factors 1/2. The dimensions are 4+2+2+1=9 and the maps are continuous and defined over the actual coefficient field.

KTR13: projection of an arbitrary original Selmer cocycle and the section reconstruction yield a single primitive for all nine matrix coordinates. The original universal IsExt-to-IsModular implication, fixed iota, marked-point premise and local conditions are retained. No smaller trace-zero adjoint or strengthened endpoint antecedent replaces literal RigII.

resolved_findings.finding: Make the transfer of inertia triviality to conjugate places explicit.
resolved_findings.resolution: The final frozen text states H-conjugation invariance and c-inversion of alpha and delta; this is the exact disconnected action and resolves the point.
